settings.title: Settings
settings.nurseryHint: Nursery mode keeps the maximum volume low. Place the device across the room from the crib — never in or on it — and use the sleep timer rather than playing all night.

playbackNotification.channelDescription: Shown while a sleep mix is playing

field.label: Orbit mixer field
field.hint: Tap a sound to place it

bedtime.title: Bedtime start
bedtime.note: The current mix stays silent until then and fades in at that time. SleepRings has to stay open (it may run in the background) — closing the app cancels it.
bedtime.nativeNote: If the app is closed, you'll get a notification at that time instead of the sound — tap it to open SleepRings.
bedtime.notificationBody: It's bedtime. If your mix isn't playing, tap to open SleepRings.

alarm.title: Wake alarm
alarm.note: Fades in gently at wake time. It only sounds while SleepRings stays open (it may run in the background) — closing the app turns the alarm off.
alarm.nativeNote: If the app is closed, you'll get a notification instead of the sound.
alarm.closedAppSound: Fades in gently at wake time, at alarm volume — even if SleepRings is closed. Tap Stop in its notification or open SleepRings to stop it.
alarm.exactNeeded: To sound the alarm even when the app is closed, allow “Alarms & reminders” for SleepRings.
alarm.closedAppSoundIos: Fades in gently at wake time while SleepRings is open. If it's closed, the system alarm sound rings instead — tap Stop on the alarm to turn it off.
alarm.exactNeededIos: To sound the alarm even when the app is closed, allow alarms for SleepRings in Settings.

share.lockedBody: Some sounds in this shared mix are available from {{tier}}, so they were left out.

mixer.presetLimit: Preset slots were full — “{{name}}” was replaced.
mixer.notificationsDenied: Notifications are off, so there's no backup if the app is closed. The in-app timing still works.

upgrade.title: Upgrade needed
upgrade.bodyGeneric: Upgrading to {{tier}} unlocks more sounds and more layers.

layerLimit.replaced: Layers are full — replaced the oldest sound.
layerLimit.blocked: Every orb is locked, so nothing could be replaced. Unlock one or upgrade.

settings.upgradeHint: Want more sounds and layers? Consider upgrading.
